title: 560亿美元收购：或撤回改谈合作，eBay会接受吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: GameStop and Ebay, this is an interesting one, so GameStop very slightly higher Ebay down about 3% Ryan Cohen, changing his attitude just a little bit, sources say GameStop
segments.zh: GameStop和eBay，这很有趣，GameStop微涨，eBay下跌约3%，瑞安·科恩态度略有转变，消息人士称GameStop

segments.en: is considering withdrawing that bid for Ebay's EO Ryan Cohen, though may instead propose a partnership that would let Ebay leverage GameStop's 1600 U.S. retail locations.
segments.zh: 正在考虑撤回对eBay的收购要约，但可能转而提议合作，让eBay利用GameStop在美国的1600家实体店。

segments.en: Joining us now is Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschales. Bailey, this is interesting because this might actually be in fact doable, whereas the previous suggestion didn't seem to be that doable.
segments.zh: 现在连线彭博社的贝利·利普沙尔斯。贝利，这很有趣，因为这实际上可能可行，而之前的提议似乎不太可行。

segments.en: No, that's spot on, Bonnie. This was a deal that went announced, kind of went viral for all of the wrong reasons if you're Ryan Cohen, and if you're the members of that GameStop team, the big question
segments.zh: 没错，邦妮。这笔交易宣布后，对瑞安·科恩和GameStop团队来说，以各种错误的方式走红，大问题是

segments.en: was, how do you fund and take over, again, not necessarily taking out a company, but going out and acquiring company worth, magnitude more than you are worth, but this does kind of
segments.zh: 如何融资并收购一家规模远超自身的公司，但这也确实

segments.en: strike the kind of balance between what Ryan Cohen has been arguing is that Ebay poorly run in his view, really needs new blood, new life, and this is a partnership that
segments.zh: 在瑞安·科恩所主张的eBay管理不善、需要新血液之间取得平衡，而这次合作

segments.en: as Leon a Baker broke out, could benefit both companies because you're looking at Ebay, which is kind of doing fine, and then GameStop really has these brick and mortar stores,
segments.zh: 正如莱昂·贝克所说，可能对两家公司都有利，因为eBay表现尚可，而GameStop拥有实体店，

segments.en: that they could benefit from selling products. So they've leaned into things like getting baseball and trading cards graded, leaning into other kind of levers to pull as people buy video games more and more on the system.
segments.zh: 他们可以通过销售产品受益。所以他们开始涉足棒球卡和交易卡评级，以及其他手段，因为人们越来越多地在系统上购买视频游戏。

segments.en: So this could be a big step forward, as you mentioned, though GameStop basically flat and Ebay down about 3%.
segments.zh: 所以这可能是一大步，如你所说，尽管GameStop基本持平，eBay下跌约3%。

segments.en: Well, that's the thing, does Ebay need physical locations?
segments.zh: 嗯，这就是问题所在，eBay需要实体店吗？
